title: 特殊退汇需要哪些条件
summary_zh: 通知对A类企业、单笔金额以及超过180天或无法原路退回的货物贸易退汇设置了银行办理条件，仍需证明真实合理并核对其他规定。
summary_en: The special-refund provision specifies enterprise category, transaction amount, elapsed time and non-original-route cases. Bank review of the transaction and other applicable provisions remain part of the process.
tradex_workflow: Collect the original receipt, contract and refund explanation; route changed beneficiary details to explicit review.
cash_effect: A proposed refund is a conditional outflow until accepted and scheduled.
source_title: 关于进一步优化贸易外汇业务管理的通知
embedding_text:
特殊退汇需要哪些条件
通知对A类企业、单笔金额以及超过180天或无法原路退回的货物贸易退汇设置了银行办理条件，仍需证明真实合理并核对其他规定。
The special-refund provision specifies enterprise category, transaction amount, elapsed time and non-original-route cases. Bank review of the transaction and other applicable provisions remain part of the process.
Keywords: 退款, 退汇, 超过180天, 原路退回, refund, beneficiary
